ideas.title: The cart's motor on a rope: winch anything up the beach
ideas.goal: Before it goes on the cart, the player stakes the new iron-stator motor in the sand with a rope on its drum and hooks the rope to whatever they like: a driftwood log, a boulder, the empty cart, the cart with friends aboard. The motor hauls it or stalls by its solved torque; the player rebuilds it (turns on the iron, how many pots, drum diameter as the gear: a thin drum pulls hard and slow, a fat one fast and weak) until it drags the loaded cart up onto the plank track. Fun because it is a test bench for anything on the island, and the cart's own drive is designed by hauling real things
ideas.toward: road step 'An iron-cored wound stator: the motor gets strong enough for a wheel'; the motor that wins this goes onto the cart unchanged
ideas.idea: nothing is tuned to a load: the stator core as softiron.jl segments magnetised by the coil's current, saturating at Ms; gap field from em.jl plus the coil; torque on the rotor from I dl x B (motor.jl) against back-EMF; coil and pots in one circuit.jl loop with I^2R heat warming the copper (resistance rises, torque falls); the rope as a chain of stretchy rods in PrintSim between the drum and any body; the load's resistance from what it is (a log sliding by sand friction, the cart rolling in WheelSand, a friend's mass from mesh volume x density). Whatever is hooked on, the same solve decides: hauled, crawling, or stalled with the rope taut
ideas.form: the motor staked on the south beach in the human's game (wrought iron horseshoe, varnished copper coil, oak drum, hemp rope), the hook playable in Jump in (E on anything); a traced film following the rope from the drum to the cart creeping up onto the planks

ideas.title: A friend in a treadwheel powers the winch down a cord
ideas.goal: A friend runs inside a big wooden treadwheel that turns the old stone motor backwards as a dynamo; a copper cord carries its current across the beach to the winch, which lifts whatever is hooked on. When the winch takes the load the treadwheel gets heavy and the runner slows; the pony keeps it turning, the crab cannot. Fun because the player watches power travel from a creature's legs through two machines to a lifted log, and picks who runs
ideas.toward: road step 'The motor run backwards: a generator', with the winch as its load (power carried over a cord, as the cart will carry it from the jar)
ideas.idea: the dynamo is motor.jl driven by the wheel: motional EMF (v x B).dl, current through circuit.jl (the cord's real resistance by length) into the winch motor; the back-torque from that current on the treadwheel; the runner's push from a general force-speed line of a running animal (F = m g mu_grip x (1 - v / v_run), mass from mesh volume x density, v_run from its species) so its speed is the torque balance, not a multiplier
ideas.form: a treadwheel beside the winch on the beach in the human's game, friends climb in by themselves; a film from the runner along the cord to the rising log
